notes: I changed the model from "always 0" to a bounded region: E2 shows f returns 1 for x in [-1, 2] (including -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, 2) and 0 outside (at -2 and 5). The boundaries are inferred as the tightest bracket consistent with the data: -1 is the smallest observed 1, -2 the largest observed 0 below; 2 the largest observed 1, 5 the smallest observed 0 above.
